1.english_reference: Joash [ was ] seven years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ יֹאָ֣שׁ בְּ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Ὢν ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν Ἰωὰς ἐν τῷ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Septem annórum erat Ioas cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Joash [ was ] seven years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: et quadragínta annis regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem .

1.english_reference: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Zibiah of Beersheba

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִ בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ἀβιὰ ἐκ Βηρσάβεε .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Sebía de Bersabée .
traditions.KJV: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Zibiah of Beersheba .

2.english_reference: And Joash did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַשׂ יוֹאָ֛שׁ הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כָּל יְמֵ֖י יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַ כֹּהֵֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ἰωὰς τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον Κυρίου πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας Ἰωδᾶε τοῦ ἱερέως .
traditions.VUL: Fecítque quod bonum est coram Dómino cunctis diébus Ióiadæ sacerdótis .
traditions.KJV: And Joash did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest .

3.english_reference: And Jehoiada took for him two wives

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּׂא ל֥ וֹ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע נָשִׁ֣ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῷ Ἰωδᾶε γυναῖκας δύο ,
traditions.VUL: Accépit autem ei Ióiada uxóres duas ,
traditions.KJV: And Jehoiada took for him two wives ;

3.english_reference: and he begat sons and daughters

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֖וֹלֶד בָּנִ֥ים וּ בָנֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας .
traditions.VUL: e quibus génuit fílios et fílias .
traditions.KJV: and he begat sons and daughters .

4.english_reference: And it came to pass after this

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֖י אַחֲרֵי כֵ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα ,
traditions.VUL: Post quæ
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass after this , [ that ]

4.english_reference: Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: הָיָה֙ עִם לֵ֣ב יוֹאָ֔שׁ לְ חַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ καρδίαν Ἰωὰς ἐπισκευάσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: plácuit Ioas ut instauráret domum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD .

5.english_reference: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבֹּץ֮ אֶת הַ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγεν τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς Λευείτας
traditions.VUL: Congregavítque sacerdótes , et Levítas ,
traditions.KJV: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites ,

5.english_reference: and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ הֶ֡ם צְא֣וּ לְ עָרֵ֪י יְהוּדָ֟ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐξέλθατε εἰς τὰς πόλεις Ἰούδα
traditions.VUL: et dixit eis : Egredímini ad civitátes Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah ,

5.english_reference: and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God

traditions.WLC: וְ קִבְצוּ֩ מִ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל כֶּ֜סֶף לְ חַזֵּ֣ק אֶת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹֽהֵי כֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συναγάγετε ἀπὸ παντὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἀργύριον κατισχῦσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: et collígite de univérso Israel pecúniam ad sartatécta templi Dei vestri
traditions.KJV: and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God

traditions.WLC: מִ דֵּ֤י שָׁנָה֙ בְּ שָׁנָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἐνιαυτὸν κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτόν ,
traditions.VUL: per síngulos annos ,
traditions.KJV: from year to year ,

5.english_reference: and see that ye hasten the matter

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֖ם תְּמַהֲר֣וּ לַ דָּבָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ σπεύσατε λαλῆσαι ·
traditions.VUL: festinatóque hoc fácite .
traditions.KJV: and see that ye hasten the matter .

5.english_reference: Howbeit the Levites hastened [ it ] not

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א מִֽהֲר֖וּ הַֽ לְוִיִּֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν οἱ Λευεῖται .
traditions.VUL: Porro Levítæ egére negligéntius .
traditions.KJV: Howbeit the Levites hastened [ it ] not .

6.english_reference: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֣א הַ מֶּלֶךְ֮ לִֽ יהוֹיָדָ֣ע הָ רֹאשׁ֒ וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἰωὰς τὸν Ἰωδᾶε τὸν ἄρχοντα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ
traditions.VUL: Vocavítque rex Ióiadam príncipem , et dixit ei :
traditions.KJV: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him ,

6.english_reference: Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection

traditions.WLC: מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ לֹֽא דָרַ֣שְׁתָּ עַל הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ הָבִ֞יא מִֽ יהוּדָ֣ה וּ מִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֶת מַשְׂאַת֙
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τί οὐκ ἐπεσκέψω περὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν τοῦ εἰσενέγκαι ἀπὸ Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ τὸ κεκριμένον
traditions.VUL: Quare tibi non fuit curæ , ut cógeres Levítas inférre de Iuda et de Ierúsalem pecúniam ,
traditions.KJV: Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , [ according to the commandment ]

6.english_reference: [ according to the commandment ] of Moses the servant of the LORD , and of the congregation of Israel

traditions.WLC: מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֔ה וְ הַ קָּהָ֖ל לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ὑπὸ Μωυσῆ ἀνθρώπου θεοῦ , ὅτι ἐξεκλησίασεν τὸν Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: quæ constitúta est a Móyse servo Dómini , ut inférret eam omnis multitúdo Israel
traditions.KJV: of Moses the servant of the LORD , and of the congregation of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: לְ אֹ֖הֶל הָ עֵדֽוּת
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου ;
traditions.VUL: in tabernáculum testimónii ?
traditions.KJV: for the tabernacle of witness ?

7.english_reference: For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י עֲתַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַ מִּרְשַׁ֔עַת בָּנֶ֥י הָ פָרְצ֖וּ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι Γοθολία ἦν ἡ ἄνομος , καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῆς κατέσπασαν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Athalía enim impiíssima , et fílii eius , destruxérunt domum Dei :
traditions.KJV: For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God ;

7.english_reference: and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim

traditions.WLC: וְ גַם֙ כָּל קָדְשֵׁ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֔ה עָשׂ֖וּ לַ בְּעָלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ γὰρ τὰ ἅγια οἴκου Κυρίου ἐποίησαν ταῖς Βααλείμ .
traditions.VUL: et de univérsis , quæ sanctificáta fúerant in templo Dómini , ornavérunt fanum Báalim .
traditions.KJV: and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim .

8.english_reference: And at the king ’s commandment they made a chest

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς Γενηθήτω γλωσσόκομον
traditions.VUL: Præcépit ergo rex , et fecérunt arcam :
traditions.KJV: And at the king ’s commandment they made a chest ,

8.english_reference: and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנֻ֛ הוּ בְּ שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה חֽוּצָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τεθήτω ἐν πύλῃ οἴκου Κυρίου ἔξω .
traditions.VUL: posuerúntque eam iuxta portam domus Dómini forínsecus .
traditions.KJV: and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD .

9.english_reference: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנוּ ק֞וֹל בִּֽ יהוּדָ֣ה וּ בִֽ ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κηρυξάτωσαν ἐν Ἰούδᾳ καὶ ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Et prædicátum est in Iuda et Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem ,

9.english_reference: to bring in to the LORD the collection [ that ] Moses the servant of God [ laid ] upon Israel in the wilderness

traditions.WLC: לְ הָבִ֤יא לַֽ יהוָה֙ מַשְׂאַ֞ת מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד הָ אֱלֹהִ֛ים עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ מִּדְבָּֽר
traditions.LXX: εἰσενέγκαι Κυρίῳ , καθὼς εἶπεν Μωυσῆς παῖς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ .
traditions.VUL: ut deférrent sínguli prétium Dómino , quod constítuit Móyses servus Dei super omnem Israel in desérto .
traditions.KJV: to bring in to the LORD the collection [ that ] Moses the servant of God [ laid ] upon Israel in the wilderness .

10.english_reference: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כָל הַ שָּׂרִ֖ים וְ כָל הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν πάντες ἄρχοντες καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαός ,
traditions.VUL: Lætatíque sunt cuncti príncipes , et omnis pópulus ,
traditions.KJV: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced ,

10.english_reference: and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבִ֛יאוּ וַ יַּשְׁלִ֥יכוּ לָ אָר֖וֹן עַד לְ כַלֵּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσέφερον καὶ ἐνέβαλλον εἰς τὸ γλωσσόκομον ἕως οὗ ἐπληρώθη .
traditions.VUL: et ingréssi contulérunt in arcam Dómini , atque misérunt ita ut implerétur .
traditions.KJV: and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end .

11.english_reference: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king ’s office by the hand of the Levites ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֡י בְּ עֵת֩ יָבִ֨יא אֶת הָֽ אָר֜וֹן אֶל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת הַ מֶּלֶךְ֮ בְּ יַ֣ד הַ לְוִיִּם֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἰσέφερον τὸ γλωσσόκομον πρὸς τοὺς προστάτας τοῦ βασιλέως διὰ χειρὸς τῶν Λευειτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque tempus esset ut deférrent arcam coram rege per manus Levitárum
traditions.KJV: Now it came to pass , that at what time the chest was brought unto the king ’s office by the hand of the Levites ,

11.english_reference: and when they saw that [ there was ] much money ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ רְאוֹתָ֞ ם כִּי רַ֣ב הַ כֶּ֗סֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς εἶδον ὅτι ἐπλεόνασεν τὸ ἀργύριον ,
traditions.VUL: ( vidébant enim multam pecúniam ) ,
traditions.KJV: and when they saw that [ there was ] much money ,

11.english_reference: the king ’s scribe and the high priest ’s officer came and emptied the chest ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֨א סוֹפֵ֤ר הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וּ פְקִיד֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָ רֹ֔אשׁ וִ יעָ֨רוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣ אָר֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ γραμματεὺς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ὁ προστάτης τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ μεγάλου καὶ ἐξεκένωσεν τὸ γλωσσόκομον ,
traditions.VUL: ingrediebátur scriba regis , et quem primus sacérdos constitúerat : effundebántque pecúniam quæ erat in arca :
traditions.KJV: the king ’s scribe and the high priest ’s officer came and emptied the chest ,

11.english_reference: and took it , and carried it to his place again .

traditions.WLC: וְ יִשָּׂאֻ֖ הוּ וִֽ ישִׁיבֻ֣ הוּ אֶל מְקֹמ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέστησαν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: porro arcam reportábant ad locum suum :
traditions.KJV: and took it , and carried it to his place again .

11.english_reference: Thus they did day by day ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה עָשׂוּ֙ לְ י֣וֹם בְּ י֔וֹם
traditions.LXX: οὕτως ἐποίουν ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ,
traditions.VUL: sicque faciébant per síngulos dies .
traditions.KJV: Thus they did day by day ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּֽאַסְפוּ כֶ֖סֶף לָ רֹֽב
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήγαγον ἀργύριον πολύ .
traditions.VUL: Et congregáta est infiníta pecúnia .
traditions.KJV: and gathered money in abundance .

12.english_reference: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתְּנֵ֨ הוּ הַ מֶּ֜לֶךְ וִֽ יהוֹיָדָ֗ע אֶל עוֹשֵׂה֙ מְלֶ֨אכֶת֙ עֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ Ἰωδᾶε ὁ ἱερεὺς τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα εἰς τὴν ἐργασίαν οἴκου Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Quam dedérunt rex et Ióiada his , qui prǽerant opéribus domus Dómini :
traditions.KJV: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD ,

12.english_reference: and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְי֤וּ שֹׂכְרִים֙ חֹצְבִ֣ים וְ חָרָשִׁ֔ים לְ חַדֵּ֖שׁ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμισθοῦντο λατόμους καὶ τέκτονας ἐπισκευάσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: at illi conducébant ex ea cæsóres lápidum , et artífices óperum singulórum ut instaurárent domum Dómini :
traditions.KJV: and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD ,

12.english_reference: and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ גַם לְ חָרָשֵׁ֤י בַרְזֶל֙ וּ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת לְ חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ χαλκεῖς σιδήρου καὶ χαλκοῦ ἐπισκευάσαι τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: fabros quoque ferri et æris , ut quod cádere cœ́perat , fulcirétur .
traditions.KJV: and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίουν οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα ,
traditions.VUL: Egerúntque hi qui operabántur indústrie ,
traditions.KJV: So the workmen wrought ,

13.english_reference: and the work was perfected by them ,

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּ֧עַל אֲרוּכָ֛ה לַ מְּלָאכָ֖ה בְּ יָדָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη μῆκος τῶν ἔργων ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et obducebátur paríetum cicátrix per manus eórum ,
traditions.KJV: and the work was perfected by them ,

13.english_reference: and they set the house of God in his state , and strengthened it .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּעֲמִ֜ידוּ אֶת בֵּ֧ית הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֛ים עַל מַתְכֻּנְתּ֖ וֹ וַֽ יְאַמְּצֻֽ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστησαν τὸν οἶκον Κυρίου ἐπὶ τὴν στάσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνίσχυσαν .
traditions.VUL: ac suscitavérunt domum Dómini in statum prístinum , et fírmiter eam stare fecérunt .
traditions.KJV: and they set the house of God in his state , and strengthened it .

14.english_reference: And when they had finished [ it ] , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada ,

traditions.WLC: וּֽ כְ כַלּוֹתָ֡ ם הֵבִ֣יאוּ לִ פְנֵי֩ הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ וִֽ יהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶת שְׁאָ֣ר הַ כֶּ֗סֶף
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς συνετέλεσαν , ἤνεγκαν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ πρὸς Ἰωδᾶε τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ ἀργυρίου ,
